# Agent Hatchers

> An Australian, founder-led AI studio. We install Hermes — a client's own AI platform where each agent owns one clear business job from request to finished deliverable: sales follow-up, document generation, invoice processing, website updates and more. One agent, job done. Clients talk to their agents in Slack or Microsoft Teams — both are supported and clients can switch between them at any time, since it is a setting rather than a rebuild — or in Hermes directly. Simple pricing: own it from $10,000 then $499/month, step up to $25,000 including 10 agents, go bespoke from $50,000, or rent platform access for $949/month without agents included. AI usage is billed at cost through OpenRouter — clients pay per token used, not per seat, and can swap the underlying AI model with one click.

## Product
- [Homepage](https://agenthatchers.com/): The authoritative entry point — what Hermes is, the interactive agent demo, how installation works, and how to book.
- [Watch Hatchy work](https://agenthatchers.com/#demo): Interactive replay of real Hatchy conversations inside Slack and Microsoft Teams — a slash command from a human, then Hatchy reading the client's systems, showing its working, attaching finished deliverables, and pausing for approval before anything is sent. A Slack/Teams toggle replays the identical conversation in either app. Four agents shown: invoices, sales, documents, website. Includes one-click model swapping.
- [How it works](https://agenthatchers.com/#how): Three steps — we install Hermes and connect it to the client's existing tools; the client picks agents (ready-made at set prices, custom-built, or self-built in plain English); the agents start working.
- [Why Hermes](https://agenthatchers.com/#why): The four-part argument — pay-per-token pricing via OpenRouter instead of fixed subscriptions; hundreds of pre-installed skills so output sounds like the client, not a chatbot; one-click model swapping with no vendor lock-in; complete separation between agents.
- [Agent library](https://agenthatchers.com/#agents): Ready-made agents at set prices (Sales, Document, Invoice, Support, Website), custom agents quoted up front, and unlimited self-built agents included with every installation.
- [Security in plain English](https://agenthatchers.com/#security): Eight plain-English guarantees, each with an everyday analogy — single-tenant (your own platform, not a shared one), least-privilege per-agent access, human approval before anything leaves the building, OAuth rather than password sharing, full readable audit log, no customer data used for model training, client-side revocation at any time, and named accountable founders. Includes a plain-English-to-technical translation table for IT reviewers.
- [Pricing](https://agenthatchers.com/#pricing): Four ways in — own it from $10,000 then $499/month, step up to $25,000 including 10 agents, go bespoke from $50,000, or rent platform access for $949/month without agents included. AI usage billed at cost.

## Company
- [About Agent Hatchers](https://agenthatchers.com/#trust): Founder-led — Hyein Yu (Founder, Head of Engineering) architects every installation; Noah Webb (Co-founder, CEO) runs every client relationship. Australian team, same-timezone delivery.
- [FAQ](https://agenthatchers.com/#faq): Authoritative answers on what Hermes is, what an agent is, pricing, why not just use ChatGPT, building your own agents, whether clients must choose between Slack and Teams (they do not), whether passwords are needed (they are not), how to switch it off, and support.
- [Book a call](https://calendly.com/noah-automationbuilders/30min): 30-minute call — a live Hermes demo, a fit assessment, and a price on the spot.
